title: The Moon's Night Light

pages.text: The moon looked down at the dark earth and felt a little bit lonely in the big night sky.
Suddenly, a tiny firefly named Flicker flew up high, blinking his bright yellow light.
'Don't worry, Moon!' buzzed Flicker. 'I'll stay here and keep you company tonight.'
Soon, hundreds of fireflies joined Flicker, dancing like stars around the smiling moon.

moral: Friends can make the darkest night feel bright and warm.
